statement: The v27 A1 make-environment card (goal_cejel_v27_a1_makefile_addopts_environment_2026-11-04) told the session to name a run whose environment comes from an expression as not read 'as #648 does'. A one-fixture probe on main showed #648 does not: readGithubRunSteps drops an env: PYTEST_ADDOPTS holding ${{ }}, so a direct pytest step is read as running with no setting and its skipped file is rated hollow. The session applied the not-read rule to make commands only, which was its scope, and filed the direct-step gap as cejel #669 instead of reusing a precedent that did not exist. Rules: when a card cites an existing behaviour as the model for a new one, run one fixture of that behaviour on main before building on it; a cited precedent is a claim to verify, not a fact; and where the probe shows the precedent missing, stay in scope and file the gap rather than widening the change or copying the missing rule.
